description: Act on one of the signed-in member's supply orders. decision "accept" PAYS THE QUOTE'S TOTAL FROM THEIR WALLET and sends the order to be placed with the store; say the total and confirm before calling. "decline" turns a quote down (nothing is charged). "cancel" withdraws a request that hasn't been quoted yet. order_id is the 8-character order number or the full id. If the wallet is short, load it first with checkout_link.
name: decide_supply_quote
title: Accept or decline a supply quote
